messages:
alex: heads-up — customer reported Console audit viewer CSV export missing rows and truncating event_payload. they have org-scoped audit_viewer role but export button is disabled. anyone seen this?

maria: saw something similar in staging. export button greyed out for audit_viewer. looks like permissions refactor regressed the export check path.

liam: ouch. we explicitly promised self-serve exports for audit_viewer in dedicated/hosted docs. need to confirm intended policy and patch asap. cc @maria

maria: confirmation from spec: audit_viewer should be able to export CSV/JSON (redacted). only users with kms:decrypt (or security_admin) can get decrypted PII in exports. export action must also emit an audit event.

ciara: UX note: current Console export only dumps the visible page (25 rows). customers expect "export all matching filters". we need a job-based export for full-range + preview header in modal.

sam: support ticket #4921: customer requested 30d export (~90k rows) and got 25 rows + event_payload like `{"id":...` truncated. they're escalating for compliance.

maria: schema changes we rolled out: event_version="2", event_id, canonical_user_id, resource_type, resource_id, redacted_fields (array). Exporter must include event_version and redacted_fields; nested event_payloads must be serialized as a JSON string column.

alex: KMS integration: for private deployments we can offer decrypted exports if requester has kms:decrypt scope. UX must require re-auth (MFA) and we should encrypt the export at rest and audit the decrypt action.

june: privacy/compliance: any decrypted export is a high-sensitivity action. must record export_decrypted audit_event with key_id, requester id, and TTL. Also require approver in some orgs.

maria: validators: before returning or exporting any audit event, run schema validation (required fields: event_id, user, action, timestamp, event_version). normalize older schema (v1->v2) server-side. failing events should be rejected and logged.

ciara: pagination design: POST /api/audit_exports {filters,page=all,format=csv,json, decrypt=false} returns job_id. worker streams to S3 or internal download, sets content-type, and returns signed URL. Job metadata must include filters, row_count_estimate, requestor, and whether decrypted. UI shows progress, honor RBAC.

liam: UX copy: modal should say: "Export will include N rows. Decrypted fields will be redacted unless you re-authenticate. Exports are retained for 7 days." Provide CSV/JSON toggle and a small header preview like: 
```
"event_id","timestamp","user","action","resource_type","resource_id","event_version","redacted_fields","event_payload"
```
Include an example row in the preview, and a checkbox: "I confirm this export may contain sensitive data."

alex: edge cases: very large event_payloads (free text) break CSVs with newlines/quotes. solution: JSON-stringify payload, escape newlines, cap payload size and mark `payload_truncated` boolean column. also enforce UTF-8 normalization and base64 fallback for binary blobs.

maria: current bug root cause: permissions service still consults legacy flag `team.permissions.export_audit` and our new role-mapping doesn't populate it for org-scoped audit_viewer. quick fix: map audit_viewer -> export_allowed true in perm sync. long-term: unify check to roles + scopes.

ops-bot: deploy 1779854372: main -> canary (eng-console) succeeded :rocket:

maria: repro steps in staging: 1) create user; 2) grant org-scoped audit_viewer role; 3) login to console -> audit; 4) apply filter service=auth; 5) try export CSV -> button disabled. /api/check-permissions returns 403 for export action because legacy flag missing.

alex: short-term: map role -> export flag (small patch). medium-term: implement job-based export with KMS-aware decryption flow + export_decrypted audit event + retention controls.

ciara: I'll draft modal flows and copy. two CTA options: "Export (redacted)" and "Export (include decrypted fields — requires re-auth)". mock by EOD Tue.

sam: I'll update KB with workaround: org-admin can call POST /internal/audit_exports {filters, export_all=true} and then share signed URL. note customers must escape newlines in CSV and watch for truncated payloads.

maria: action items: maria -> fix perm mapping (PR+deploy); alex -> spec export job + KMS flow; ciara -> UX mock + copy; june -> compliance text + audit_event schema; sam -> support KB. timeline: perm mapping patch by EOW, job+UX in next 2 sprints.

liam: thanks team. @maria ping me when you open PR so we can test with enterprise staging KMS keys.

alex: adding automated validation: CI test that exported CSV header exactly matches canonical header asset. unit test in eng-runtime repo to fail on header drift.

audit-bot: ticket created: SEC-EXPORT-1147 (audit export RBAC + large export UX) assigned to maria.

maria: noted. will update thread with PR link and staging repro notes.
